polityNote: Dahomey (Benin from 1975-11-30) since independence 1960-08-01. Atoms: the 546 arrondissements of 2021 (OpenStreetMap/uMap via geoBoundaries BEN ADM3, the finest of the three gb levels: 31,591 vertices against 1,437 for ADM1). Each arrondissement was placed in its department through its commune (ADM2 commune polygons, then the official commune list), cross-checked against geoBoundaries ADM1 and Natural Earth admin-1: 525 of 546 agree on all three; the 21 others were settled by the commune each arrondissement belongs to (e.g. Ségbohoué and Agbanto in Kpomassè, Cotonou 1er–13e in Littoral, Porto-Novo 1er–5e in Ouémé). Communes since 2003 keep the territories of the former sous-préfectures, and each department of 1975–1999 is exactly two of the twelve (the 1999 law split each in half; statoids 1975 areas equal the sums of the later ones within 0.2%). ① Areas (atom union / statoids; statoids swaps Ouémé and Plateau, whose official areas are 1,281 and 3,264 km²): Atacora (1975) 31866/31200 km² = 1.021; Borgou (1975) 52160/51000 km² = 1.023; Zou (1975) 19398/18700 km² = 1.037; Mono (1975) 4095/3800 km² = 1.078; Atlantique (1975) 3318/3220 km² = 1.030; Ouémé (1975) 4570/4700 km² = 0.972; Alibori 26528/25683 km² = 1.033; Atakora 20625/20459 km² = 1.008; Atlanique 3235/3233 km² = 1.001; Borgou 25632/25310 km² = 1.013; Collines 14129/13561 km² = 1.042; Kouffo 2468/2404 km² = 1.027; Donga 11241/10691 km² = 1.051; Littoral 82/79 km² = 1.039; Mono 1626/1396 km² = 1.165; Oueme 1304/2835 km² = 0.460; Plateau 3266/1865 km² = 1.751; Zou 5268/5106 km² = 1.032.
